name: Simple MA+ADX EA
summary: This EA combines a Simple Moving Average (SMA) crossover with the ADX indicator to identify and trade trending markets. It enters long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA and ADX confirms trend strength, and enters short on the reverse crossover with ADX confirmation. Exits are triggered by opposing crossover signals or stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA结合简单移动平均线(SMA)交叉与ADX指标来识别和交易趋势市场。当快速SMA上穿慢速SMA且ADX确认趋势强度时做多，反之做空。出场依靠反向交叉信号或止损/止盈。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是利用双移动平均线交叉判断趋势方向，同时借助ADX指标过滤震荡行情，只在趋势明确时入场。入场条件为：快速SMA上穿慢速SMA且ADX值高于阈值时开多单，快速SMA下穿慢速SMA且ADX值高于阈值时开空单。出场条件包括：反向SMA交叉信号平仓、固定止损止盈平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未实现动态仓位调整。资金管理方面较为简单，仅依赖止损和止盈参数控制单笔风险，缺乏基于账户余额或波动率的动态风险管理机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但风险控制手段有限，缺乏对震荡行情中连续假信号的防护措施。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy uses dual moving average crossovers to determine trend direction while leveraging the ADX indicator to filter out range-bound markets, entering only when a trend is confirmed. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the fast SMA crosses above the slow SMA and ADX exceeds its threshold, and open a short position on the reverse crossover with ADX confirmation. Exit conditions include closing positions on opposing SMA crossover signals or hitting fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management is relatively simple, relying solely on stop-loss and take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk, lacking dynamic risk management mechanisms based on account balance or market volatility. The overall strategy logic is clear, but risk control measures are limited, and there is no protection against consecutive false signals during choppy market conditions.
pros: ADX过滤震荡行情，减少假信号造成的亏损交易
双均线交叉逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调优
策略参数较少，降低了过拟合的风险
止损止盈设置明确，每笔交易风险可控
适合趋势明显的市场环境，盈亏比较高
pros_en: ADX filter reduces choppy market false signals and unnecessary losing trades
Dual MA crossover logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize
Fewer strategy parameters reduce the risk of overfitting to historical data
Defined stop-loss and take-profit provide clear per-trade risk control
Performs well in strongly trending markets with favorable risk-reward ratios
cons: 固定手数无法根据市场波动率或账户风险动态调整仓位
均线交叉信号存在明显滞后性，入场点可能远离最佳价位
缺乏加仓和减仓机制，无法在趋势发展中优化持仓
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
ADX阈值在不同品种和周期上需要分别优化，通用性有限
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust positions based on market volatility or account risk
MA crossover signals have inherent lag, often entering far from optimal price levels
No scaling in or out mechanism to optimize positions as trends develop
Lacks new bar check, risking multiple entries on the same bar
ADX threshold requires separate optimization per symbol and timeframe, limiting universality
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，使风险控制适应市场波动率变化
添加新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线上重复发出交易信号
实现基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to adapt risk control to changing market volatility
Add new bar detection to prevent duplicate trade signals on the same bar
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lots

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致仓位失控
固定手数不随账户规模调整，小账户容易过度杠杆
均线滞后性在震荡行情中可能导致连续止损
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same bar leading to position overload
Fixed lot size does not scale with account size, risking over-leveraging on small accounts
MA lag in ranging markets can lead to consecutive stop-loss hits

Exits are triggered by opposing crossover signals or stop-loss/take-profit levels.
